name: Appearance
overview: Scripture reveals that human appearance reflects God's creative design, as man is made in His image (Genesis 1:27) and wonderfully fashioned (Psalms 139:14). However, outward appearance can be deceptive, as favor and beauty are fleeting and true worth is found in fearing the Lord (Proverbs 31:30). Believers are warned against judging solely by external looks, being called to exercise righteous judgment rather than superficial evaluation (John 7:24), and to beware of hypocrisy that masks inner sin with outward righteousness (Matthew 23:28). Additionally, God’s moral order includes distinctions in appearance and conduct, such as the prohibition against cross-dressing (Deuteronomy 22:5), underscoring the importance of honoring God’s design in our outward presentation.
